Pages were chosen from text-layer titles and rendered pages before any parser run on these files. Page numbers are 1-based PDF positions.
annotation: Single-assistant visual transcription checked against every selected rendered page before the first parser run on these files. A text-layer listing independent of jpfs was used only as a transcription aid. Paths, units and dates are explicit and follow the earlier batches' conventions (totals under their section even when printed at the heading's indentation; wrapped labels joined; 内訳 groups nest their items). The gold's own totals were checked against their members within display rounding. Not independently human-adjudicated.
